description: The bar chart illustrates the relative performance of three models, RedWhale, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), across six categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the relative performance values, ranging from approximately 0.4 to 1.0, with a linear scale and no explicit label or units. The bars are grouped by category, with each group consisting of three bars colored dark blue (RedWhale), light blue (EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0), and gray (SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0), representing the respective models. The gray bars consistently reach 1.00 across all categories, while the dark blue and light blue bars vary in height, with the dark blue bars ranging from approximately 0.42 to 0.70 and the light blue bars ranging from approximately 0.46 to 0.74. The bars within each group are not stacked, and the categories are not sorted in a specific order. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bar or category.
